strings: r_c immediately sends m_c over to the medicine cat den upon hearing a series of coughs. m_c is much more susceptible to whitecough due to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} cleft palate, and r_c is determined to ensure the disease does not become worse.

As a result of m_c's cleft palate, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is} left with whitecough. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/feel/feels} trapped in the medicine cat den, itching to go out and serve {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clan once more.
